source.label: Google Sheets · AgentData
assumptions: One row is treated as one agent × assign_month record.
Rates are preserved exactly as supplied and are not averaged to create team totals.
Day, week, and month-to-date measures are current snapshots from AgentData columns L:W; historical day/week snapshots are not available.

metricDefinitions.label: Leads
metricDefinitions.definition: Total leads assigned to the agent in the source row.

metricDefinitions.label: Logins
metricDefinitions.definition: Total partner logins attributed to the source row.

metricDefinitions.label: Demos
metricDefinitions.definition: Total demos attributed to the source row.

metricDefinitions.label: Conversions
metricDefinitions.definition: Total conversions attributed to the source row.

metricDefinitions.label: Target attainment
metricDefinitions.definition: Achievement divided by the configured target. Undefined until a reviewed target is supplied.

source.label: Target configuration · not supplied
assumptions: No target fields exist in the linked AgentData tab. Target and attainment remain unset until reviewed monthly targets are added.

source.label: Google Sheets · AgentData historical periods
assumptions: Rows are aggregated to one agent per period_type and period_start.
DAY, WEEK, and MONTH periods are read directly from the refreshed Connected Sheets query.
Leads, logins, demos, and conversions are additive counts at the selected period grain.

metricDefinitions.label: Leads
metricDefinitions.definition: Leads created in the selected historical period.

metricDefinitions.label: Logins
metricDefinitions.definition: Logins in the selected historical period.

metricDefinitions.label: Demos
metricDefinitions.definition: Demos in the selected historical period.

metricDefinitions.label: Conversions
metricDefinitions.definition: Conversions in the selected historical period.
